titleBack: The Ultimate Power In The Universe

flipToBack.timing: Required trigger on blown-away completion (event timing, not standing state; no isTableChanged/canBeFlipped guard)
flipToBack.prose: Natively flips when Alderaan (system) is 'blown away' - i.e., the classic Commence Primary Ignition epic event completes against Alderaan. An Inkling Of Its Destructive Potential supplies a separate temporary external flip route and flips this objective back at end of turn.

expression.req: timing trigger: Alderaan system blown-away last step

flipToFront.timing: NEVER flips back. Back instead has a place-out-of-play (lose) trigger and a blown-away Force-loss amplifier.
flipToFront.prose: The Ultimate Power In The Universe is placed out of play if Death Star (system) is 'blown away' (TriggerConditions.isBlownAwayLastStep on Filters.and(CardSubtype.SYSTEM, Filters.title(Title.Death_Star, true)) -> PlaceCardOutOfPlayFromTableEffect). Additionally, if Yavin 4 system is blown away, adds 3 to opponent's blown-away Force loss for each opponent's Yavin 4 site (isBlownAwayCalculateForceLossStep -> AddToBlownAwayForceLossEffect).

requirementSemantics: Flip is a pure EVENT-TIMING trigger (isBlownAwayLastStep), not a board-state check: no control/occupy/presence/with semantics anywhere in the flip law. The only route to flipping is executing Commence Primary Ignition against Alderaan.
Back hard-lose is the mirror event: Death Star system blown away places the objective out of play - the Death Star must be protected (Rebels' Attack Run / CPI threat).

Front's Force-drain cancel at Death Star sites is required and automatic, gated by an owner drain there: TriggerConditions.forceDrainInitiatedBy(game, effectResult, playerId, Filters.Death_Star_site) - it cancels the OWNER'S OWN drains at Death Star sites (and battle damage there is prevented by NoBattleDamageModifier), with a ModifyGameTextType.SET_YOUR_COURSE_FOR_ALDERAAN__ONLY_AFFECTS_DARK_SIDE_DEATH_STAR_SITES variant narrowing to your Death Star sites.
typedIdentities: Filters.Deployable_By_SYCFA (second start-of-game location: Alderaan system or per-filter equivalents e.g. Jedha City)

Filters.Commence_Primary_Ignition may target only Filters.or(Filters.Alderaan_system, Filters.Yavin_4_system, Filters.Hoth_system, Filters.Subjugated_system) (MayNotBeTargetedByModifier on all other planet systems)
Filters.Star_Destroyer / Filters.Victory_class_Star_Destroyer (deploy -2 / -1 to Death Star system)

Filters.and(Filters.battleground_system, Filters.sameSystemAs(self, Filters.Star_Destroyer)) drains +1; +2 variant via Filters.or(Filters.Imperial_class_Star_Destroyer, Filters.Super_class_Star_Destroyer)
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game deploys Death Star system, one location matching Filters.Deployable_By_SYCFA (Alderaan system slot), and Docking Bay 327 from Reserve Deck (front:60-84).
Front tutor: once during each of your deploy phases, take one card with 'Death Star' in title into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (Filters.titleContains("Death Star"), front:135-154).
Back pull: once during each of your deploy phases, deploy one battleground system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (Filters.system + Filters.battleground, BACK:81-107).
otherObligations: Front, remainder of game: Revolution is canceled (action proxy, front:87-126); Commence Primary Ignition may target only Alderaan/Yavin 4/Hoth/Subjugated planet systems (front:127-131).
Front: you may not Force drain at Alderaan system (front:161).

Front: at Death Star sites your Force drains are canceled (required trigger front:178-187) and battle damage against you is canceled (NoBattleDamageModifier front:162-163); a game-text modification can narrow both to YOUR Death Star sites (front:171-175).
Back: your Star Destroyers deploy -2 (Victory-class -1) to Death Star system (BACK:113).
Back: your Force drains +1 at battleground systems with your Star Destroyer (+2 if Imperial- or Super-class present) (BACK:114-115).
Back: if Yavin 4 system blown away, +3 Force lost per opponent's Yavin 4 site (BACK:51-65).
Back LOSE condition: placed out of play if Death Star is blown away (BACK:68-76) - the Death Star system must be defended for the rest of the game.

profileGaps: The native front flip remains deliberately absent from flipLocationRules because it is an event pipeline (Alderaan blown away by classic Commence Primary Ignition), not a standing control/occupy/presence condition. Shared SetYourCourseObjectivePolicy and exact ObjectiveAnalyzer facts own the executable route.
No representation of the front's own-drain cancellation at Death Star sites / no-drain-at-Alderaan restrictions that shape pre-flip play.

observed: classic setup chooses Alderaan over Jedha City when the CPI route is available
objective pull and top-of-Reserve child choose Central Core
deploy, battle, control, and Force-loss choices preserve the exact next movement payment and route assets
Death Star follows parsec 0 to 1 to 2, chooses orbit, and selects Alderaan over a decoy system
a converted Light Side Alderaan remains the source-true orbit and blow-away target
classic Commence Primary Ignition blows away Alderaan and the unchanged objective flips natively
back-side Death Star blown-away hard-loss defense is active only after the native flip and recognizes Attack Run deployed at the Trench

On The Verge routing recognizes converted Scarif, pursues Scarif only on its front, then releases its deploy reserve, parent movement, and child choice after its native flip; this is compatibility regression coverage, not an On The Verge behavior seal
